name: Sol Good I
text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
Sol Good I
“Well now, I didn’t ‘spect ya’d stick ta workin’ them mines like ya have. It’s a rough life down underground, but ya just keep diggin’ and diggin’. Ain’t no mistakin’ it now. Ye’ve become a fair miner. I reckon ye’re ready ta come along with me inta the Grotto.”

“Now, there’s two things ya best know ’bout the Grotto. First off, it ain’t like them mines ye’ve been diggin’ so far. It gets mighty warm down there. So ya best take care ye don’t work yerself to a boil. Second, ye’re gonna need yerself some new pickaxes. Them rocks and minerals down there are a mite tougher than what ye’ve come ‘cross so far.”

“Bring me some pickaxes, and I’ll fix ’em up proper so ya can work the Grotto.”

name: More Shells, Please I
text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
More Shells, Please I
Geist found a most wonderful shell for her collection two nights ago. As she was enjoying one of her secret flights, that she only does when it’s cloudy and no one can see her, she soared over a small island. Right at that moment, the tiniest bit of moonlight snuck through the clouds and glinted off something in the water. It spooked Geist at first, but after flying a few circles around the island she found no one around. So, she decided to investigate. As she dropped from the clouds to get a closer look she realized that the glint was from a shell! It was an incredible shell that looked just like a unicorn’s horn!

You may not know this, but unicorn shells are incredibly difficult to find. They’re nearly as rare as unicorns themselves. The shells are also named after the legendary creatures because of their restorative powers. When Geist was young, she even got to help heal a sick dragon once using a unicorn shell poultice. They’re truly amazing shells!

Now, it looks like it may be a while before Geist can get out to fly around and look for more unicorn shells. Would you be willing to bring her any you happen to find?

name: One Shell of a Summer
text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
One Shell of a Summer
The war is over. The frogs moved on to other areas and left a shell-strewn wasteland in their wake. Thankfully, most of the cicadas are gone and you can finally hear yourself think again.

frank sits on a tree stump nearby, munching on a carrot. "i don't know, star, i'm just saying if i was him, i would have let the people go."

Star rubs his temples and says, "frank, what are you talking about?"

"nevermind. different universe. you know my name is npc_bunny1 in that one? weird place. i don't recommend it."

"Do you think we saved enough cicadas to get a good reading?" Rosalie asks.

Star slowly nods. "No thanks to the longhaired lepus, here, but yes. I think we did."

"who are you calling longhaired, you two-bit excuse for a birthday party magician!" Bits of carrot fly out of frank's mouth as he shouts.

Star stands up suddenly and makes a noise you previously thought impossible for a man or wizard to make. Without another word, he disappears with a resounding *POP* leaving nothing behind but a pile of feathers and a wizard hat next to Rosalie. A moment later, he pops back, grabs Rosalie, then they both disappear with an even bigger mound of feathers.

frank looks at you with mischief in his eyes.

"i'll pay for that later, but i'm just going to savor the moment for now. say? how about another bag of carrots for the road? and thanks for your help! if you hadn't tagged along, why i'd... i'd still have done everything the exact same... why did i bring you again?"

He doesn't leave you time to answer, but you know why. He takes the bag of carrots and disappears in a puff of blue feathers. You look around at the mess left behind. You crack your knuckles and get to work cleaning it up before the next adventure sweeps you off again.

Cicadas again.

Thousands of them. There must be more in these woods than in Misty Forest! You can't even hear yourself think.

"this is it!" You can barely hear frank's voice above the cacophony. "they're around here somewhere!"

That's when you see them.

An army of frogs blanketing the earth and hopping your way. The ground trembles as millions of fat, green bellies launch into the air and land in unison.

You aren't really sure what's happening, but you stand as still as you can as a wave of frogs washes past you, eating every bug in sight.

"Come on, {player}, we need to save as many as we can!"

It's Rosalie! What's she doing here? She and Star are in the middle of the procession, collecting as many cicadas as they can get their hands on.

"These frogs are ruining my experiments! It must be the ambifacient lunar waneshaft... On a Saturday for crying out loud! Come on! We might still save enough for my hesitation injection capacitor!"

"Take some frogs out while you're at it!" shouts Rosalie. "Every little bit helps!"

You're drenched in sweat by the time you reach the Misty Forest. The sound of the cicadas is deafening and the ground is littered with their shells along the base of every tree.

frank is already waiting on you. He's leaning against a tree with... is that another pile of carrot stems? How long has he been waiting on you? And where is he putting all of those carrots!?

"great! you're finally here. i was almost out of carrots and was tempted to try corn for the first time..." frank visibly shudders as he speaks. "you... did bring more, right?"

You hand frank another bag of carrots and he begins walking into the forest. You follow.

"so, most people think cicadas are just noisy insects, but that's only because most people can't hear the other sound. the buzzing you hear is just the physical part. beneath that is a second resonance. star has been hoping to discover how to tap into it."

frank stops and scrunches his nose.

"smell that? sea salt... i know where he went next! to the emerald beach!"

More blue feathers erupt from nowhere as frank once again vanishes into thin air.

name: Following the Buzz
text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
Following the Buzz
"so, the last place I saw star was right... here!"

You have no idea why you're standing on top of Holger's chimney, but at this point, you've stopped asking questions as they relate to the affairs of wizards.

"on a saturday, meerif? what were you thinking?"

frank pulls out a carrot from his... pocket? You're not really certain you want to know for sure.

"well—" he smacks loudly on the carrot "—you hear that?"

The only thing you can hear is the smacking.

"the only sensible thing from here is that he went straight into misty forest. you hear those cicadas? star loves the darn things. says they could be the key to unlocking that 'non-matter energy' he's always on about. say, you got any more of those carrots? we've got a long walk ahead. well. you do, at least."

Without another word, frank disappears in a cloud of blue feathers. You sigh as you climb down from Holger's roof and prepare for the long walk to the Misty Forest.

name: Frankly Speaking

Buddy's Almanac
Settings
Frankly Speaking
"pssst!"

You look around, but don't see anything unusual.

"hey! you! down here! under the tree!"

You turn your head to the sound and see a familiar blue face and ears. Frank is sitt—"that's frank!"

...You're not quite sure how he knew you had capitalized his name in your own thoughts, but it's probably best not to think about it too hard. At any rate, frank is sitting at the base of an apple tree. A pile of carrot stems lays next to him. Something tells you they're from your own garden.

That something would be correct.

"hey. gotta question for you. have you seen star lately? or soonly, for that matter?"

Come to think of it, it has been a while since you've seen the resident wizard.

"yeah, me neither. care to help me find him? not really a question. come on!"

Pleasantly Arbitrating Misconstrued Relational Affronts, Troubles Skirted I
Potatoes and steaks served as a main course, the brothers quickly fall into a conversational pattern that can only be describe as tense, but friendly. Their topics are far and varied, but almost completely superficial in nature until Borgen begins to slowly describe his travels.

“You see, at first I thought this area was quite droll, but the forest behind our dear {player}’s house was so charming, I found all manner of delightful things, collectibles, valuables, and the like. I may have even spent a little time fishing in the pond. {player} can tell you! Stones! They’re Redbrook’s notary, I bet they’ll confirm all of my claims!”

It's unclear why he's talking about such common areas of Redbrook, but you realize it's your duty as a notary to help confirm these things and keep the claims honest between the brothers. There's a level of braggadocio that you find concerning in his words, even as the description is quite calm.

text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
Pleasantly Arbitrating Misconstrued Relational Affronts, Troubles Skirted III
Borgen stands up, first looking indignant, but with a throaty laugh and back slap he leads Holger into your living room. They both light up pipes together and take a moment before Borgen speaks up.

“Brother, there is change coming to our lands, and we’ve got to be ready to meet it head on. The reemergence of wizards, the unrest in Bahltruvia, that business with 'Alghavaz', I’ve been preparing, slowly. Those coins hold a significance you don’t yet understand.”

He flips a singular coin into the air, it glints in the light of your home before his hand reaches up almost too quickly to see, grabbing it from midair - as he opens his palm, the coin is gone completely.

“Your venture though, it sounds…interesting. Perhaps we should explore it together? I’d like to show you some rarities I picked up from various places around greater Redbrook and even passing into the great Romuskan desert. Those wastes are no place for sane men.”

Holger studies Borgen intently as Borgen hands you another list to verify and notarize.

Buddy's Almanac

Pleasantly Arbitrating Misconstrued Relational Affronts, Troubles Skirted IV
The list passes from Borgen to you to Holger, and Holger studies it for a moment with a furrowed brow.

“It seems, it seems we are on similar paths indeed, my good brother. Your efforts and observations of our world have not been in vain. I’ve also noticed we could be in need of some support in the fair town of Redbrook in the coming years, so I’ve come up with an alternative solution, inspired by you actually. Using my standard operating accumulated profit system, I’ve discovered a way to help generate what we need and incentivize our good friend at the same time…”

In a moment, you realize Holger has the self-same determined look of mischievousness and intensity as his brother. It’s at once encouraging and terrifying. You wonder if you’ve misjudged the man based on his love of potatoes for all these years.

“You see, my search yielded results in the Misty Forest - the amber there, it reminded me of one of your belts, and it was there I found the basis for my future idea!”

Holger hands you another list to notarize.

name: Pleasantly Arbitrating Misconstrued Relational Affronts, Troubles Skirted V
text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
Pleasantly Arbitrating Misconstrued Relational Affronts, Troubles Skirted V
As you notarize the list and pass it back to Borgen, their conversation continues, almost as if you aren’t there.

“Ah yes, belt number 42?"

Borgen trails off, lost deep in thought for a moment. He effortlessly threads a coin between his fingers while he’s thinking. The absentmindedness of the gesture is astounding, his dexterity is akin to magic by your eyes.

He continues, almost to himself, "What could you possibly do with amber? What madness are you brewing Holger? The world has enough turmoil as it is without having two irresponsible members of the family... one of us has to look out for all of us..."

Borgen flips the old coin to his other hand, the subconscious motions are at once a delight and mystifying.

Holger gives a start at this final declaration but Borgen continues on once more.

“Well, I’ve gone a few other places, perhaps this madness can be stopped. Perhaps you’d be interested to see the specimens I’ve uncovered in the canyons and the strange magic in the rivers? It couldn’t hurt. And could be a lot safer...”

Borgen hands you a list and you head off to once again verify his claims, just to be sure. It’s a notaries job, after all.

text:
Buddy's Almanac
Settings
Pleasantly Arbitrating Misconstrued Relational Affronts, Troubles Skirted VI
Holger takes the list and smiles grimly.

“Oh brother, these, they won’t do at all. And what in stars and stone is belt 42? No no no, magic is useless to me, I’m a simple man with a simple plan. These bugs might make a good snack though…”

Holger trails off and he looks hungrily towards your pantry. More and more, Holger begins to seem a different person in your eyes. He is craftier and more instinctive than you have previously observed. Maybe he’s always been this way, or maybe Borgen brings it out of him, you’re not quite sure.

“Well, I thought dragons were the answer, but the Mountain was as fruitless as ever. The skulls of some long forgotten war are littered there though, but have little value it seems, except as a reminder of a world we know nothing about. Still, maybe you’d be interested?”

Holger hands you back the list, and you go about your notarial duties. Maybe you need to petition the board of T’rah’s Notaries for an increase in maximum allowable fees...
